notes: Job CBPAUP0J step STEP01 (DFSRRC00 PARM='BMP,CBPAUP0C,PSBPAUTB'): IMS enters CBPAUP0C as a BMP, PROCEDURE DIVISION USING the I/O PCB and the one DB PCB of PSB PSBPAUTB (CMPAT=YES, PROCOPT=AP). It reads the PRM-INFO card from SYSIN (expiry 13 days, checkpoint frequency 00002 so CHKP fires, debug N; with 05 expiry days the first summary's DLET answers DJ and the step abends, RC 16, on both sides), walks the pending-authorization database DBPAUTP0 (HIDAM: PAUTSUM0 root, PAUTDTL1 child) with GN / GNP, deletes (DLET) each expired detail and each emptied summary, and takes basic checkpoints (CHKP ID). The database is the corpus's own HD unload (data/EBCDIC/AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.IMSDATA.DBPAUTP0.dat: 22 roots, 202 children), laid out by CIPAUSMY / CIPAUDTY; the step's DISPLAY output, RETURN-CODE and the database as the step leaves it are compared. The DL/I model is register family I (tests/equivalence/ims/ggdli.c, cobolrt/dli/DetDli.java), #5857. faults.name: debug-on
faults.why: #5857: the debug flag Y: every DL/I call DISPLAYs its segment (the DEBUG-ON branches)

faults.name: card-defaults
faults.why: #5857: a card with only the expiry: the checkpoint frequency and display frequency default to 5 and 10

faults.name: nothing-expires
faults.why: #5857: an expiry no authorization reaches: no DLET, no emptied summary (the NOT-QUALIFIED-FOR-DELETE branch)

faults.name: expiry-abend
faults.why: #5857: with 5 expiry days the first summary's DLET answers DJ and the step abends (RC 16) on both sides

faults.name: gn-error
faults.why: #5857: the summary GN answers AM: AUTH SUMMARY READ FAILED and the step abends

faults.name: gnp-error
faults.why: #5857: the detail GNP answers AM: AUTH DETAIL READ FAILED and the step abends

faults.name: dlet-detail-error
faults.why: #5857: the first detail DLET answers AM: AUTH DETAIL DELETE FAILED and the step abends

faults.name: chkp-error
faults.why: #5857: the first CHKP answers AM: CHKP FAILED and the step abends

faults.name: debug-expiry-abend
faults.why: #5857: with the debug flag the summary DLET DISPLAYs first, then answers DJ and the step abends

faults.name: checkpoint-display-compare
faults.why: #5857: a display frequency of 0000 and a blank: the count (8 digits) sorts above that alphanumeric field, so the final CHKP DISPLAYs its count (the WS-NO-CHKP >= branch)

faults.name: checkpoint-freq-compare
faults.why: #6072: a checkpoint frequency of four blanks and a 1: not SPACES and not 0, so it is kept, and the summary count (8 digits) sorts above that alphanumeric field (a blank sorts below '0'), so WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT > P-CHKP-FREQ is true after every summary and the CHKP fires each time (the checkpoint-frequency true branch). A basic CHKP drops the database position, so the next GN reads the first summary again and the step would never end: the third GN answers AM and the step abends (RC 16) on both sides

faults.name: expiry-not-numeric
faults.why: #5857: a non-numeric expiry falls back to 5 days (the IS NUMERIC false branch)
